original_test_intent: Verify the intended FPGA temperature resource across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web, including exact component identity, description, value, units, state and freshness against the component-specific SPEC.
original_method: Prove common target identity, establish board/FPGA/telemetry mapping, collect complete unfiltered command views and the protected Web row in a bounded interval, normalize all fields and compare to the correct FPGA SPEC without clearing logs or altering FPGA, SDR or thermal controls.
manual_activity: A platform reviewer approves which FPGA and telemetry source TEMP_FPGA represents, then visually confirms the Web row and cross-view SPEC result.
safety_requirements: Reject generic label without component mapping
agent_execution_scope: Collect full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists
Normalize identity, description, value, units, state, thresholds and timestamp
engineer_actions: Approve FPGA component and sensor mapping
Resolve competing FPGA labels or divergent views

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The exact-name OOB query can corroborate one backend record, but truncated SDR cannot cover all command views and the generic FPGA name does not prove the physical target.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Collect full IB/OOB lists and the Web row after binding TEMP_FPGA to one documented component and management telemetry source.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The five-view comparison and source timing remain; generic clear and first-100-line evidence are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Attach board location, FPGA function/device identity and telemetry source to one timestamped five-view comparison object.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds physical component disambiguation and source binding to the generic label.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A valid temperature from a different FPGA can satisfy syntax and numeric range while missing the intended device.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: If firmware aggregates or proxies multiple FPGA regions, that behavior must be documented in the SPEC rather than inferred.

project_override_considerations: Define the exact FPGA instance, board location/function, telemetry source, fields, limits and time tolerance. The private Script requires pinned review; other FPGA rows do not establish equivalence.
expected_evidence: Board/FPGA inventory and TEMP_FPGA source map
Complete decoded IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists
Protected Web row and page context

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently target a generic FPGA sensor across five views. Component ambiguity is a readiness input; DeepSeek incompleteness and generic clearing are method defects.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The component map, parsers, access and SPEC are identifiable package inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED if TEMP_FPGA cannot be bound to a unique or documented aggregate device after obtaining them.

review_improvement: Makes the generic FPGA label auditable to one physical management resource and restores all five source-required views.
independent_technical_reasoning: Platforms can contain several FPGAs with different placement, cooling and junction limits. A label match and plausible temperature cannot establish which silicon is measured; correct acceptance requires an authoritative component-to-telemetry binding before comparing cross-interface values and thresholds.
